resources.string: Spatial Wall
Install Spatial Wall from your PC

Keep Spatial Wall open on a PC on the same local network. Register using its QR code or six-digit code. This starter downloads the full app from that PC, verifies it, and asks Android to install it. Your registration will carry over. It does not contact an external download server.
